field.override-destination: Override the destination with the sniffed domain
help.enable: For traffic whose real domain can't be read directly (Tun / Redir / TProxy, ...), sniff it out and use it for rule matching.
help.override-destination: Whether the sniffed domain replaces the actual destination address, as a global default; each protocol below can override it.
help.sniff.HTTP.ports: Ports to sniff for HTTP on; leave empty to use Mihomo's own built-in default ports.
help.sniff.TLS: Leave with no sub-fields to enable TLS sniffing, defaulting to port 443.
help.sniff.QUIC: Leave with no sub-fields to enable QUIC sniffing, defaulting to port 443.
